title: The establishing shot, tilt-shift (second pass)
asked: the user, 9 November 2026: a tilt-shift effect at the start of the film framing the nuclear power plant with the Enerhodar crossing, city and place names shown; the next shot zooms in and rotates

scene.from: the crossing's 3D scene as south_look3 builds it (scene.json, camera_south_look3.json's look, extras plant, land_south, others); only the camera is new

date_state.lines: the last reported state (11 September 2026): Ferosplavna-1 connected, Dniprovska cut; the plant's other lines cut; the units' links to the thermal plant lit with the line feeding them
date_state.from_frame: camera_south_look3.json frame 2400 (0-based): its imagery weights, water level and colour, wet band, plants' growth and every line's state, held

camera.why: A's view, slid sideways so the plant and the crossing sit about the frame's centre (the plant at x ~720, the lines' landing on the south shore ~1190, the north bank's landing ~1650 of 1920)
camera.push: 4.5% nearer the look-at point over the shot, eased in and out (cosine); no turn, no sideways drift
camera.statement: A viewing point and path, designed; not an observation.

tilt_shift.method: a focal plane, vertical, through the plant and the lines' landing on the north bank; each pixel blurred by k * |1/t_focus - 1/t| (t: the distance Blender rendered for what the pixel shows; t_focus: where the pixel's own ray meets the plane), less a dead zone, eased (tanh) into a ceiling, smoothed, then a stack of Gaussian blurs in linear light, each pixel between the two nearest

grade.name: slate
grade.why: desaturated, cool slate-teal shadows and faintly warm highlights: an editorial map look
grade.then: the look's vignette x0.7 and grain
grade.statement: a grade (white balance, contrast, saturation, split tone): no colour painted

tilt_shift.statement: A drawn effect, a lens's depth of field imitated; the scene is at its true size. Blur hides detail, it adds none.

names.style: as the maps set them: SF Pro, mixed case, light text with a soft dark halo, no boxes; a small dot on each place with its name beside it; the water in italic, letter-spaced, a muted blue, set along its course; the crossing's name along the lines; never blurred; fading in one after another from 1.6 s over 1.2 s, 0.3 s apart

shown_last_frame.text: Power lines to the north bank
